title: A distributional modelling approach with application to electricity price forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.01465v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The increasing volatility of electricity prices driven by renewable energy integration, market shocks, and regulatory changes has reinforced the need for forecasting methods that go beyond point predictions and accurately describe the full conditional price distribution. This paper applies the Generalised Additive Models for Location, Scale and Shape (GAMLSS) framework to forecast Spanish day-ahead electricity prices using hourly data from 2020 to 2024. Alternative specifications based on Normal, Johnson's SU (JSU), and Sinh-Arcsinh (SHASH) distributions are considered, allowing the location, scale, and shape parameters to vary with market fundamentals, including electricity demand, renewable generation, seasonal effects, and regulatory and geopolitical risk factors. translated_title: 一种分布建模方法及其在电价预测中的应用
translated_abstract: 受可再生能源并网、市场冲击以及监管变化推动，电价波动性日益加剧，这强化了对超越点预测、能够准确刻画完整条件价格分布的预测方法的需求。本文应用位置、尺度和形状广义可加模型（GAMLSS）框架，基于2020年至2024年的小时级数据对西班牙日前电价进行预测。研究考虑了基于正态分布、Johnson's SU（JSU）分布和Sinh-Arcsinh（SHASH）分布的多种替代设定，使位置、尺度和形状参数能够随电力需求、可再生能源发电量、季节效应以及监管和地缘政治风险因素等市场基本面因素的变化而变化。预测采用滚动窗口方法生成，并通过平均绝对误差（MAE）、pinball损失和Diebold-Mariano检验进行评估。结果表明……
tldr: 本文将GAMLSS分布建模框架创新性地应用于西班牙日前电价预测，通过允许分布的位置、尺度和形状参数随市场基本面变化，实现了超越传统点预测的完整条件价格分布刻画。
en_tdlr: This paper innovatively applies the GAMLSS framework to forecast the full conditional distribution of Spanish day-ahead electricity prices, allowing location, scale, and shape parameters to vary with market fundamentals, going beyond traditional point forecasts.
